h: Up the top end of town
p: Bull Street is the bit of Birmingham city centre that climbs from the Corporation Street shops towards Colmore Row and Snow Hill, so this MERKUR sits in the more businessy, office-worker end of town rather than down by the Bullring. The West Midlands Metro trams run right along Bull Street, and Snow Hill station is a few minutes up the hill, which makes it easy to reach without the car.

It's an 18+ venue, strictly adults. If you're in town with time to spare, St Philip's Cathedral and its leafy churchyard are just round the corner, and the shops at Grand Central and the Bullring are an easy walk downhill. City-centre parking is pricey, so the tram or train is the smarter shout.
